statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because NQ is closed; Stress remains extreme as Riyadh-area security and Hormuz/energy-route risks remain unresolved.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; weekend geopolitical and energy uncertainty is represented primarily in Stress until NQ price discovery resumes.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress with NQ closed and Saudi risk unresolved
body: NQ futures are closed, so current continuation, pullback and session-extreme behavior cannot be observed. Reuters reports the cause of flames and smoke near Riyadh airport remains unclear, while Hormuz traffic remains far below recent averages. Friday's Nasdaq close retained two-way structure despite chip-led gains.

lookbackSummary: Over the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail peaked at 24% during Friday's event/whipsaw conditions and fell below WATCH after the close. Weekend Tail stayed low while Stress rose from the mid-70s to 90% as Saudi security and energy-route risk intensified.
outlookSummary: All 24 forecast slots precede Sunday NQ reopening. Without fresh escalation, Stress can ease modestly while Tail remains low; Saudi/Hormuz deterioration could raise reopening-gap risk, but future one-way structure cannot be treated as observed before trading resumes.
